caribbean.headline: Roatan Faces Moderate Winds, 5.8 ft Waves Today
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing maximum sustained winds of 24 kt and wave heights up to 5.8 ft, with a 25% rain probability. Grenada remains calm with winds at 0 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Cadiz Faces Light Winds, Small Swell Today
mediterranean.paragraph: Cadiz is experiencing maximum sustained winds of 12 kt and wave heights of 2.1 ft, with less than 10% rain probability. I note that Mykonos reports calm conditions with 0 kt winds.
